description:
What an inventory is realistically worth. The inventory valued three ways, plus what selling would actually raise. `at_asks` is the headline number
(each skin at its cheapest Steam listing, falling back to the best buy order); `at_bids` is every skin at its
best buy order; `at_recent_sales` is every skin at its latest Steam median sale price (the inventory chart's
basis). `sell_now` walks each skin's real buy-order ladder for the quantity held: `units_sellable` of
`units_held` could be sold instantly for `gross` (what buyers pay) and `net_after_fees` (after Steam's 15%).
`biggest_ask_gaps` lists the skins whose cheapest listing sits furthest above their recent sales - thin order
books where the headline is least reliable. All cents. Uses the stored holdings (the last lookup) and current
order books: never a live Steam call; look the inventory up first if `found` is false. No key needed. Use when asked what an inventory is REALLY worth or would sell for: asks vs bids vs recent sales, and instant-sell proceeds after Steam's 15% fee.
name: get_inventory_valuation
title: What an inventory is realistically worth
